execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."contact" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "description" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "occurredAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."fileLink" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."label" (
  "color" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."patient" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "email" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."patientLabel" (
  "labelId" text NOT NULL,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("patientId", "labelId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."practice" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "description" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."referral" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "sold" bool NOT NULL,
  "soldAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reminder" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "description" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "targetDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "occurredAt" timestamptz,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduledAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessionAnnotation" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "recordedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessionLabel" (
  "labelId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("sessionId", "labelId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "practiceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
